questions.text: Solve for x: 5x - 7 = 23
questions.explanation: 5x - 7 = 23, so 5x = 30, giving x = 6.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Simplify: (2/3) + (1/6)
questions.explanation: Using a common denominator of 6: (2/3 = 4/6) + (1/6) = 5/6.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find x if 9x + 4 = 6x + 25
questions.explanation: 9x + 4 = 6x + 25, so 3x = 21, giving x = 7.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is 15% of 480?

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: The average of 8 numbers is 12. What is their sum?
questions.explanation: Sum = average x count = 12 x 8 = 96.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Solve: x^2 - 49 = 0
questions.explanation: x^2 = 49, so x = sqrt(49) = +-7, giving x = 7 or x = -7.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: If the ratio of boys to girls in a class is 3:4 and there are 12 boys, how many girls are there?
questions.explanation: 3 parts = 12, so 1 part = 4. Girls = 4 parts = 4 x 4 = 16.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is the perimeter of a rectangle with length 12cm and width 7cm?
questions.explanation: Perimeter of a rectangle = 2(length + width) = 2(12+7) = 2 x 19 = 38cm.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is the area of a circle with radius 7cm? (Use pi = 22/7)

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Simplify: 2^3 x 2^4
questions.explanation: When multiplying powers with the same base, add the exponents: 2^3 x 2^4 = 2^7 = 128.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is the value of the square root of 169?
questions.explanation: The square root of 169 is 13, since 13 x 13 = 169.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: A motorist travels 150km in 2.5 hours. What is their average speed?
questions.explanation: Average speed = distance/time = 150/2.5 = 60 km/h.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Solve for x: (x/5) + 4 = 9

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is the sum of the interior angles of a heptagon (7 sides)?
questions.explanation: The sum of interior angles of a polygon = (n-2) x 180, so for a heptagon (n=7): (7-2) x 180 = 900 degrees.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is the sum of the interior angles of an octagon (8 sides)?
questions.explanation: Using (n-2) x 180 for an octagon (n=8): (8-2) x 180 = 1080 degrees.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Factorise: x^2 - 5x + 6
questions.explanation: We need two numbers that multiply to 6 and add to -5: -2 and -3. So x^2-5x+6 = (x-2)(x-3).

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is 0.75 expressed as a fraction in its lowest terms?
questions.explanation: 0.75 = 75/100, which simplifies to 3/4 when divided by 25.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: If a = 6 and b = -2, find the value of a^2 - b^2

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is the median of the data set: 5, 7, 9, 12, 18?
questions.explanation: With 5 values arranged in order (5,7,9,12,18), the median is the middle value: 9.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is the mode of the data set: 2, 4, 4, 6, 7, 4, 9?
questions.explanation: The mode is the most frequently occurring value; 4 appears three times, more than any other value.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Convert 7/8 to a percentage.
questions.explanation: 7/8 = 0.875, which as a percentage is 87.5%.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is the LCM (Lowest Common Multiple) of 4 and 10?
questions.explanation: Multiples of 4: 4,8,12,16,20...; multiples of 10: 10,20...; the smallest common multiple is 20.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is the HCF (Highest Common Factor) of 24 and 36?
questions.explanation: The factors of 24 are 1,2,3,4,6,8,12,24; factors of 36 are 1,2,3,4,6,9,12,18,36; the highest common factor is 12.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: If 2x + 3y = 18 and x = 3, find the value of y.
questions.explanation: Substituting x=3: 2(3) + 3y = 18, so 6 + 3y = 18, giving 3y = 12, so y = 4.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: A trader sells an item for N9,600 after a 20% discount on the original price. What was the original price?
questions.explanation: If N9,600 represents 80% of the original price, then original price = 9,600/0.8 = N12,000.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is the next number in the sequence: 2, 6, 18, 54, ___?
questions.explanation: Each term is multiplied by 3 to get the next term: 54 x 3 = 162.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Simplify: (3a^2b) x (5ab^2)
questions.explanation: Multiplying coefficients: 3x5=15. Multiplying a terms: a^2 x a = a^3. Multiplying b terms: b x b^2 = b^3. Result: 15a^3b^3.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is the value of x in the equation: 3(x - 2) = 2(x + 4)

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: A rectangular plot has an area of 200 square metres and a width of 8 metres. What is its length?
questions.explanation: Length = Area/Width = 200/8 = 25 metres.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is the probability of picking a blue ball from a bag containing 5 red and 3 blue balls?
questions.explanation: Total balls = 5 + 3 = 8. Probability of blue = 3/8.
